# Pro DJ Link datagrams captured from real Pioneer hardware: see README.md here.
# A DJM-2000nexus (33) turns Sync on and off on player 2, then makes player 2, player 3,
# player 2 again and finally itself tempo master. Only player 2's port was spanned.
# Source: dysentery doc/assets/Sync-Master.pcapng

# then its bytes in hex exactly as captured.

# state and one each half second per device; nothing else is left out.
